mapper.select: /* aprvInqyDao1020 : 결재 상세 조회 */ SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT AM.APRV_ID , AM.APRV_TITLE , AM.APRV_CONT , AM.PROJ_ID , P.PROJ_TITLE , AM.TEMP_CD , T.TEMP_NM , T.TEMPTYPE_CD , AM.APRVSTEP_CD , C_STEP.CODE_NM AS APRVSTEP_NM , AM.CURR_APRV_SNO , AH.APRVTYPE_CD , AH.APRV_IDX , AM.REG_IDX , TO_CHAR(AM.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DT , AM.FILE_ID , AH.RSLTTYPE_CD , E.EMP_NM , O.ORG_NM , R.RANK_NM , AL.LEAVTYPE_CD , C_LEAV.CODE_NM AS LEAVTYPE_NM , AL.LEAV_IDX , TO_CHAR(AL.LEAV_SDT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LEAV_SDT , TO_CHAR(AL.LEAV_EDT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LEAV_EDT , AL.LEAV_DAYS , AL.LEAV_RSN , AL.SUBST_IDX , SUBST_E.EMP_NM AS SUBST_NM , AE.METHOD_CD , C_PAY.CODE_NM AS METHOD_NM , AE.PREPAY_IDX , TO_CHAR(AE.PREPAY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PREPAY_DT , AE.PREPAY_RSN , AE.PREPAY_AMT , AI.REQTYPE_CD , TO_CHAR(AI.REQ_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQ_DT , C_REQ.CODE_NM AS REQTYPE_NM , AC.CARD_NM , AC.CARD_NO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AM.APRV_ID ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM APRV_MAST AM INNER JOIN APRV_HIST AH ON AH.APRV_ID = AM.APRV_ID AND AH.APRV_SNO = AM.CURR_APRV_SNO LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON E.EMP_IDX = AM.REG_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TEMPLATE T ON T.TEMP_CD = AM.TEMP_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN PROJECT P ON P.PROJ_ID = AM.PROJ_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN APRV_REL_LEAV AL ON AL.APRV_ID = AM.APRV_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO SUBST_E ON SUBST_E.EMP_IDX = AL.SUBST_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN APRV_REL_EXP AE ON AE.APRV_ID = AM.APRV_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN APRV_REL_ITEM AI ON AI.APRV_ID = AM.APRV_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN APRV_REL_CORP AC ON AC.APRV_ID = AM.APRV_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_STEP ON C_STEP.CODE_CD = AM.APRVSTEP_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_LEAV ON C_LEAV.CODE_CD = AL.LEAVTYPE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_PAY ON C_PAY.CODE_CD = AE.METHOD_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_REQ ON C_REQ.CODE_CD = AI.REQTYPE_CD ) DATA WHERE DATA.ROW_NUM = '1'

/* aprvInqyDao1030 : 결재선 조회 */ SELECT AH.APRV_ID , AH.APRV_SNO , AH.APRVTYPE_CD , C_TYPE.CODE_NM AS APRVTYPE_NM , AH.APRV_IDX , E.EMP_NM , O.ORG_NM , R.RANK_NM , AH.RSLTTYPE_CD , C_RSLT.CODE_NM AS RSLTTYPE_NM , AH.RSLT_NOTE , TO_CHAR(AH.RSLT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RSLT_DT , AH.REG_IDX , TO_CHAR(AH.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DT , AH.MOD_IDX , TO_CHAR(AH.MOD_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS MOD_DT , AH.USE_YN , AH.DISP_ORDER , AH.REMARK , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AH.APRV_SNO ASC) AS NUM FROM APRV_HIST AH LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON E.EMP_IDX = AH.APRV_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_TYPE ON C_TYPE.CODE_CD = AH.APRVTYPE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_RSLT ON C_RSLT.CODE_CD = AH.RSLTTYPE_CD WHERE AH.APRV_ID = #{aprvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY AH.APRV_SNO ASC

/* aprvInqyDao1040 : 물품 등록 조회 */ SELECT AI.APRV_ID , AI.REQ_SNO , AI.REQTYPE_CD , AI.REQ_IDX , TO_CHAR(AI.REQ_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQ_DT , AI.REQ_RSN , AI.MGT_NO , AI.ITEM_NM , AI.ITEM_CNT FROM APRV_REL_ITEM AI LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON E.EMP_IDX = AI.REQ_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_REQ ON C_REQ.CODE_CD = AI.REQTYPE_CD WHERE AI.APRV_ID = #{aprvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY AI.REQ_SNO ASC

/* aprvInqyDao1050 : 정산내역 조회 */ SELECT AC.APRV_ID , AC.CORP_SNO , AC.USE_LOC , AC.USE_AMT , AC.USE_RSN , TO_CHAR(AC.USE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS USE_DT FROM APRV_REL_CORP AC WHERE AC.APRV_ID = #{aprvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY AC.CORP_SNO ASC

/* aprvInqyDao2010 : 결재 조회 */ SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT AM.APRV_ID , AM.APRVSTEP_CD , AM.CURR_APRV_SNO , AH.APRVTYPE_CD , AM.REG_IDX , AH.APRV_IDX , AH.RSLTTYPE_CD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AH.APRV_SNO ASC) AS NUM FROM APRV_MAST AM INNER JOIN APRV_HIST AH ON AM.APRV_ID = AH.APRV_ID AND AM.CURR_APRV_SNO = AH.APRV_SNO WHERE AM.APRV_ID = #{aprvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND AH.APRVTYPE_CD = 'TYPE_0020' ) DATA WHERE DATA.NUM = '1'

/* aprvInqyDao2020 : 다음 결재 조회 */ SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT AH.APRV_ID , AH.APRV_SNO AS CURR_APRV_SNO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AH.APRV_SNO DESC) AS NUM FROM APRV_HIST AH WHERE AH.APRV_ID = #{aprvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND AH.APRV_SNO != #{currAprvSno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND AH.APRVTYPE_CD = 'TYPE_0020' AND AH.RSLTTYPE_CD IS NULL ) DATA WHERE NUM = '1'
/* aprvInqyDao2030 : 기안문 양식 조회 */ SELECT TEMP_CD AS CODE_CD , TEMP_NM AS CODE_NM FROM TEMPLATE WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY TEMP_CD ASC

/* aprvInqyDao4010 : 결재선 관리 조회 */ SELECT ALM.APRVLINE_ID , ALM.APRVLINE_NM , ALM.REG_IDX , TO_CHAR(ALM.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DT , ALM.DISP_ORDER FROM APRVLINE_MAST ALM WHERE ALM.REG_IDX = #{empIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(ALM.APRVLINE_NM),'[^0-9가-힣A-Za-z]','') LIKE '%'||REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(#{srchNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'[^0-9가-힣A-Za-z]','')||'%'

/* aprvInqyDao4020 : 결재선 상세 조회 */ SELECT ALM.APRVLINE_ID , ALM.APRVLINE_NM , ALD.APRVLINE_SNO , ALD.APRV_IDX , E.EMP_NM AS APRV_NM , O.ORG_NM , R.RANK_NM , ALD.APRVTYPE_CD , C_APRV.CODE_NM AS APRVTYPE_NM FROM APRVLINE_MAST ALM LEFT OUTER JOIN APRVLINE_DETL ALD ON ALD.APRVLINE_ID = ALM.APRVLINE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON E.EMP_IDX = ALD.APRV_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_APRV ON C_APRV.CODE_CD = ALD.APRVTYPE_CD WHERE ALM.APRVLINE_ID = #{aprvlineId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY ALD.APRVLINE_SNO ASC
/* aprvInqyDao4030 : 결재선 타입 조회 */ SELECT CODE_CD AS APRVTYPE_CD , CODE_NM AS APRVTYPE_NM FROM CODE WHERE GRP_KEY = 'Type' AND CODE_CD != 'TYPE_0010' ORDER BY DISP_ORDER ASC
mapper.insert: /* aprvProcDao1020 : 결재 이력 등록 (APRV_HIST) */ INSERT INTO APRV_HIST ( APRV_ID , APRV_SNO , APRVTYPE_CD , APRV_IDX , RSLTTYPE_CD , RSLT_DT , REG_IDX , REG_DT , USE_YN , DISP_ORDER , REMARK ) VALUES ( #{aprvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , (SELECT LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(APRV_SNO)), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM APRV_HIST WHERE APRV_ID = #{aprvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) , #{aprvtypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{aprvIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , NULL , NULL , #{regIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , SYSDATE , 'Y' , (SELECT NVL(MAX(DISP_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM APRV_HIST) , NULL )
mapper.update: /* aprvProcDao1030 : 현재 단계, 번호 수정 (APRV_HIST) */ MERGE INTO APRV_MAST AM USING ( SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT APRV_ID , APRV_SNO , APRVTYPE_CD , APRV_IDX , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY DECODE(APRVTYPE_CD,'TYPE_0020',1) ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM APRV_HIST WHERE APRV_ID = #{aprvId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) DATA WHERE DATA.ROW_NUM = '1' ) AI ON (AM.APRV_ID = AI.APRV_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET AM.CURR_APRV_SNO = AI.APRV_SNO , AM.MOD_IDX = #{modIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , AM.MOD_DT = SYSDATE
mapper.insert: /* aprvProcDao2050 : 결재선 상세 등록 처리 */ INSERT INTO APRVLINE_DETL ( APRVLINE_ID , APRVLINE_SNO , APRV_IDX , APRVTYPE_CD , USE_YN , DISP_ORDER , REMARK ) VALUES ( #{aprvlineId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , (SELECT LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(APRVLINE_SNO)), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM APRVLINE_DETL WHERE APRVLINE_ID = #{aprvlineId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) , #{aprvIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{aprvtypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , 'Y' , (SELECT NVL(MAX(DISP_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM APRVLINE_DETL) , NULL )
